chapter_title_en: Deathmatch for the Top Six — Slovenly Trulyear vs. Ninefate Trulyear
chapter_keywords: grand dao of life and death
chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly — Slovenly vs. Ninefate: The Brutal Early Match
chapter_meta_description: The top twelve are set — but the Grand Xia Emperor shocks everyone by pitting Slovenly Trulyear against Ninefate Trulyear in the first elimination. A clash of the Grand Dao of Life and Death vs. the Black Tortoise.
og_title: The Top Three Dreams Are Shattered Early
og_description: Two contenders for first place face off in the fourth round — the Grand Xia Emperor’s most controversial match yet.
twitter_title: Slovenly vs Ninefate — The Unofficial Final
twitter_description: The battle everyone wanted to see in the finals happens now — Slovenly Trulyear’s impenetrable defense meets Ninefate Trulyear’s savage Life and Death Dao.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, a Pure Yang True Immortal who oversees the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A True Immortal who has reached the apex of the Yang-aligned immortal path, possessing near-ultimate power within the Three Realms.
A Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance and drunken demeanor, but fiercely proud of his sect.
A dirty, disheveled-looking young girl who is actually one of the most terrifying cultivators in the top twelve, wielding the Grand Dao of Life and Death.
The Black-White College’s top genius, a disciple of the Black Tortoise Emperor, who combines Taiji-level defense with sudden, lethal counter-strikes.
The highest grade of magic treasure in the Three Realms, capable of storing living beings and manifesting independent pocket dimensions.

surfaces: Grand Dao of Life and Death
lore_anchors.definition: An extremely profound Grand Dao that governs the transition between life and death, granting its user both regenerative abilities and lethal attack power.
A defensive divine ability derived from the legendary Black Tortoise (Xuanwu), the divine beast of the north, granting turtle-like invulnerability and snake-like counter-attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Grand Xia Emperor match Slovenly Trulyear and Ninefate Trulyear so early?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because both were among his top seven favorites, and one had to be eliminated—he chose the only woman (Ninefate) as the most politically expendable sacrifice.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Grand Dao of Life and Death?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is an extremely profound Dao that blends the aggression of death with the nurturing regeneration of life; it is harder to master than the Dao of the Sword but offers unique combat flexibility.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Slovenly Trulyear suddenly switch from defense to attack?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His defense was tiring Ninefate Trulyear’s divine power; once she overextended, he exploited a gap with a snake-strike technique and immediately went on the offensive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Black-White College really a nexus of fortune (气运汇聚之地)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Many great powers believe so because it spawned two top-twelve geniuses; the Grand Xia Emperor’s capital was also chosen for similar geographic fortune.
